children: Injective launches Institutional Rail on 02 Nov 2026, a dedicated gateway for banks and enterprises to access block production directly. The gateway routes transactions through an Enterprise Validator mempool and provides optimistic execution results.

Institutional Rail gives these users priority inclusion in the next block, expanding Injective's institutional offering with a dedicated access route. The full validator set provides finality for transactions submitted through the gateway.
Today we are officially introducing Injective Institutional Rail.
A dedicated gateway for banks and enterprises into Injective block production, with predictable inclusion and instant finality.
